Dialogue_Text: Well, it looks like someone forgot to tell you that this is a private party! And your clothes: they reek!
Well, I heard that there is a ball of... dancing swords. I had to see if that's true!
I always go where I want!
I thought I would dance with you and your swords. Is this really such an inappropriate wish?

I thought it would be a different kind of party, but if you really are such an attention seeker, then so be it! You shall become the very center of our little dance! Get them, my beautiful things! Now!
